name: vix_mean_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when India VIX surges >4% within 10 minutes, it reflects panic-driven put buying that temporarily dislocates implied volatility above fair value. The precise entry trigger is the moment VIX stops making new highs (3 consecutive declining 5-second bars) — this signals put-buying saturation. At that inflection point, option market makers who sold the panic puts begin aggressive NIFTY futures purchases to delta-hedge their short-gamma exposure, generating a 10-25 spot-point mean-reversion bounce within 30-90 seconds. The complementary short signal fires when VIX is crushed >3% in 10 minutes at NIFTY highs — complacency at elevated levels where the same MMs delta-hedge the opposite direction as volatility re-prices up.
core_signal_oneliner: VIX spikes 4%+ in 10 minutes then shows 3 consecutive declining 5s bars, signaling put-buying saturation and options MM delta-hedge reversal
